entries.english:
Jewish school, class

Description: teacher Manfred Höxter (left) with 16 pupils; town hall in the background, Kirchstraße with bollards and chain on the right. Standing pupils, from left: Erich Hertz, Werner Elsoffer, Werner Rose, Irma Salomon, Ernst Levy, Lotte Hertz, Ilse Lina Terhoch, Löwenberg (?), Hanni Rosenberg. Kneeling, from left: Ralf Sommer, Steinberg, Rolf Kissing, Bertha Wertheim, Elsa Terhoch, Lore Terhoch, Anita Wehnes. Photographer unknown; black-and-white original photograph, 10.5 × 7.5 cm; negatives 582/00-01, 587/31-35.
